text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I did it! I—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Riiice! You were aaaawesooome!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-Urara?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heehee, yep! Here I am!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't be! We can't be<n>here—this is the
winner's circle!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Only the winner and her team are<n>allowed to stand
here!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, no problem detected. We<n>are all Team
Rice.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That was a superb race, Rice. You<n>have my
congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
During your race, Rob Roy called you<n>a tenacious
demon. My own<n>observations found that name
quite<n>fitting.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A tenacious demon?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Aaah! Bourbon! I told you to keep that<n>a secret!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It looks like I managed to live up to<n>everyone's
expectations this race!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I did, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! And you're smiling too! You<n>better keep it
up for the winning<n>concert!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We'll be there too, waving our arms<n>until they fly
off!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thanks, Urara. I'll find you in<n>the crowd... and
wave back.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A really... really big wave, so you'll<n>see it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...That said, I'm way too nervous!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
To think I would take center stage at<n>the spring
Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As the runner who defeated<n>me, you must
hold yourself with more<n>dignity.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: M-McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Without a doubt, this stage is a<n>special one. Yet
we are professionals<n>when it comes to
performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There is but one thing you must<n>convey to all the
people who have<n>come here to see you today... and
that<n>is your gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: My... gratitude?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. On the stage, we Umamusume<n>give thanks to
those who have<n>supported us and pushed us
forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Put another way, the stage is not<n>something to be
feared.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As the winner, it is an extension of<n>your duty to
shine onstage for those<n>who have lifted you up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Which is to say, I'm looking forward<n>to seeing how
you shine after such<n>an extraordinary race.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Understood!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, Mejiro McQueen heads to<n>the stage with
elegance and grace.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... She's incredible.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I need to follow her example. I must<n>meet
everyone's expectations in<n>order to show how
grateful I am...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She's right, after all... Bourbon and<n>the other racers
aren't the only<n>reason I've gotten this far...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
There are also all the people... who<n>watch my races
and support me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: All right... Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower runs off toward the<n>glittering stage.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Later in the evening...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm sorry to bring this up when<n>we just got
back, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I've decided what I want to do next!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I've decided what I want to do next!

Um... I want to live up to my fans'<n>expectations
even more.

I saw so many lights while I was<n>standing on the
stage.

I couldn't believe it... So many people<n>made me feel
like a star.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So... if my fans will allow it, I want to<n>compete in the
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen—a race in<n>which only
fan-favorites can compete.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Who would have thought this girl,<n>who I once found
crying alone on<n>campus, would now be more than
qualified for such a race?
choice_data_list: Then let's race in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yep! I'm going to give it my<n>all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That should show everyone...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: How grateful I am.
